title: 氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體
summary: 從異質接面、緩衝層到整合驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Heterojunction and Buffer layer to Integration verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 異質接面 → 常開與常關
stages.description: 把「異質接面」「極化電荷」「常開與常關」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Heterojunction, Polarization charge, Normally on/off.

steps.title: 異質接面：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.
steps.instruction: 畫 AlGaN/GaN 與能帶井，定位二維電子氣。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw AlGaN/GaN and its band well and locate the 2DEG. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「異質接面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Heterojunction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「異質接面：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：靜態導通電阻不能代表陷阱造成的動態退化。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「特殊元件工坊：功率、光電與 MEMS」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「靜態導通電阻不能代表陷阱造成的動態退化」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors as the task boundary. After reading “Heterojunction: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Static on-resistance does not represent trap-induced dynamic degradation. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Special-device workshop: power, optoelectronics and MEMS”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Static on-resistance does not represent trap-induced dynamic degradation” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「異質接面」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Heterojunction, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層
把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜
將固定極化電荷當成直接流動電流
optionsEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer
Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping
Treating fixed polarization charge as current-carrying particles
quiz.explanation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 異質接面：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「異質接面」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：界面粗糙會影響通道散射。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Heterojunction artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Interface roughness affects channel scattering. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層；界面粗糙會影響通道散射。
steps.observationEn: A heterojunction channel differs from a silicon inversion layer; Interface roughness affects channel scattering.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing the 2DEG as uniform bulk doping", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「異質接面」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「界面粗糙會影響通道散射」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Heterojunction, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Interface roughness affects channel scattering" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 異質接面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把 2DEG 畫成整片均勻體摻雜」與「異質接面通道不同於矽 MOS 反轉層」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

steps.failure: 若採用「將固定極化電荷當成直接流動電流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
